title: sabulina helmii
intro: Sabulina helmii, commonly known as Sabulina, is a type of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sabulina include its ability to protect the liver and kidneys, and its antimicrobial properties make it effective against various bacterial and fungal infections. The bioactive constituents of Sabulina helmii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
